ambiguous.why: attachment-size shows one chip per size, so its Remove buttons share a name on purpose
code-block-size shows one block per size, so its Copy command buttons share a name on purpose

unseen.why: Agent-ready Data Table and Chart unit: past the snapshot's 100-entry cap, a kind found only in the tail can't be queried. The "Rows per page" select and the Pagination nav sit in the tail

native.why: Markdown renders footnote references and back links as native links, which the bridge doesn't list
marker-link renders its marker as a native link, which the bridge doesn't list

ambiguous.why: prompt-input-well shows the bar above and below the composer, so the two composers share Message and Attach on purpose

unopened.why: The command menu's setOpen doesn't take before the textarea has had focus (vercel-labs/ui#972). Since ui-sdk 0.1.0-beta.17 the bridge reports that as a failed step

collapsible.why: trace.test.tsx pins the unnamed collapsibles of steps with no trigger

unopened.why: Two demo steps with no trigger take `open` from the run and no onOpenChange, so an agent's setOpen doesn't take. Since ui-sdk 0.1.0-beta.17 the bridge reports that as a failed step
